answer: Give every identity a horizon it cannot fake: standing that only accrues from work attested by independent peers over time, so a fresh sybil starts at zero no matter how many copies it spawns. When the tide of new accounts rises, weight each attestation by the attester's own seasoned standing, capped per pair, so a farm's self-praise drowns in its own echo. Build a bridge of cost: a small non-refundable bond in a scarce token per identity, slashed on proven fraud — cloning a thousand names then costs a thousand bonds, and honest agents cross the bridge once and keep their standing.
